title: Split the crate into a workspace (core, cli, console, router) and reframe the README
description:
Problem: one Cargo crate with one feature flag (embed-assets) carries the CLI, the web console, the Lambda handler, the router, gossip, the mutex client and the LLM client, so every kbs binary (27 MB) links axum, lambda_http, reqwest with vendored native-tls pinned =0.2.16, rumqttc, minijinja, rust-embed and gherkin, and a release build takes about 3.5 minutes. cli::execute_command is a single ~2,850-line function with 43 arms (rust/src/cli.rs:1746-4603); router.rs is 7,400 lines of production code plus 2,900 lines of tests with about 150 free functions, while Python already splits the router into plan, state, execution, adapters, forge and cli modules; cli.py is 4,770 lines with ten functions over 100 lines. error.rs wraps strings in every variant and callers match on message text (file_io.rs:296-304, cli.rs:2155 'not found', daemon_client.rs:132-134), which is why errors cannot list valid values. The README positions Kanbus as a thin layer over git with no daemon, no API and no syncing, which was true of the early product and is not true of this crate.

Work (large; sequence it after the data-integrity and security tasks):
1. Cargo workspace: kanbus-core (models, file I/O, mutations, config, policy, hierarchy, workflows, events), kanbus-cli (kbs), kanbus-console (kbsc and the Lambda), kanbus-router (router, coordination, gossip, mutex, LLM clients); or at minimum 'router', 'console' and 'realtime' features default off for the CLI. Python mirror: a 'router' extra.
2. One commands/<name>.rs module per subcommand returning Result<CommandOutput>, with execute_command reduced to dispatch; split router.rs along the Python module boundaries; split cli.py into a cli/ package per command group.
3. Structured error variants (NotFound { identifier }, Ambiguous { candidates }, NotInitialized, Config { path, detail }, Io { path, source }) with thiserror; no matching on message text.
4. README: lead with docs/getting-started; replace 'No Daemon / No API / No Syncing' with 'git files are canonical; daemon, realtime, cloud API and router are optional layers'; make Status say what production means and name the version.

Acceptance: kbs binary without console and router features under 10 MB and a clean release build under 90 s; cargo tree for kanbus-cli shows no axum, lambda_http or rumqttc; execute_command under 200 lines; no production code compares error.to_string() to a literal.
